source: actual Unity 6000.5.6f1 PlayMode frames at 1206x2622 and 60 fps
reasons: Case label TextMesh rendered over the sealed Pack instead of remaining occluded.
The free foil tail was too wide and too tall, so its curl read as an oversized ribbon.
The aperture edge opened as a broad diagonal wedge instead of a narrow moving tear front followed by a mated torn edge.
The impact flash used a pointed star silhouette and the energy ring crossed the viewport, creating an Effects Demo read.
Pack retreat culled grid cells into visible rectangular chunks instead of a coherent outward release.
The case root moved 0.075977 m in one frame, above the continuity limit.

aheadOfTearFrontRemainsWelded.cause: The fully torn endpoint was still classified as intact during Pack retreat.

corrections: Hide the case TextMesh renderers until the physical Pack handoff passes 72 percent while retaining the same case and renderer EntityIds.
Narrow the physical foil strip and tighten its cubic curl.
Reach full aperture depth shortly behind the moving front while preserving the shared seeded edge.
Replace the star with a soft aperture-shaped geometry flash and reduce the single ring radius.
Retreat coherent full-width body bands instead of individual grid cells.
Use smoothstep case travel across the same 180 ms handoff.
